name: mastra-client-checks
description: Node-side bridge process using Mastra's own first-party A2A client (@mastra/core/a2a). Spawned as a persistent subprocess by mastra_prober.py, since Mastra's A2AAgent.resumeGenerate() only works within the SAME long-lived process (its run state is an in-memory Map, not something that can be reconstructed across separate process invocations).
